positions.title: Cloud Architecture and Security Team Lead @ Connected Car Plattform
positions.description:
Cloud Architecture and Security Teamlead at the Connected Car Plattform Architecture team. 

As Cloud Architecture and Security Team Lead, I drive the design and implementation of scalable, secure architecture building blocks and provide strategic consulting to development teams across the Connected Car division. 
I lead cross-cutting initiatives to standardize cloud security and architecture practices across an ecosystem of 1,000+ developers, 1,300 microservices, and over 12 billion daily requests. 
My focus is on enabling innovation while ensuring resilience, compliance, and operational excellence at scale.

positions.title: Technical Product Owner / Cloud Security Architect @ BMW Digital Key Backend
positions.description:
Technical Product Owner and Cloud Security Architect for the BMW Digital Key Backend enabling the customer feature BMW Digital Key. 

The BMW Digital Key is an innovative feature allowing BMW Group customers to access and start their vehicles with a vehicle key securely stored on their smartphones making classic vehicle key fobs obsolete. Furthermore, the feature enables new use cases such as vehicle key sharing over iMessage and other communication channels as well as enabling BMW's Remote Controlled Parking functionality.

Key achievements:
- Scaling the user base of BMW Digital Key customers from zero to 1.4M actively used digital car keys while collaborating with various company-internal divisions (Offboard development, Onboard development, business development, after sales) and leading a team of 15 external developers.
- Active and forward-looking contribution to shaping the Digital Key specification within the Car Connectivity Consortium (for the BMW Digital Key), while representing BMW's interests in a consortium of over 200 international member companies (e.g., Apple, Google, Huawei, …), resulting in BMW having the most innovative implementation of the Digital Key.

positions.title: Technical Product Owner / Cloud Security Architect @ Map and Automated Driving Services
positions.description:
Technical Product Owner and Cloud Security Architect for the product Map and Automated Driving Services.

As a Technical Product Owner and Cloud Security Architect in the field of highly autonomous driving (L2+, L3), I was responsible for defining and delivering secure, scalable cloud solutions supporting advanced vehicle data processing and AI-driven development. 
I led cross-functional teams to align product roadmaps with security and compliance requirements, ensuring robust protection of sensitive data across global cloud environments. 

Key achievements were:
- Development and delivery of a highly secure, technical solution over several main departments at BMW for the secure delivery of highly-autonomous driving data to BMW vehicles for supporting L2+ and L3 autonomous driving capabilities
- Development of a secure system to remotely control and steer L4 autonomous driving capable vehicles in real-time on real roads using real-time video, audio and vehicle trajectory transmission over 4G / 5G networks (Teleoperation)

positions.title: IT Security Architect
positions.description:
Central IT security architect within the Connected Car and digital services IT department (ConnectedDrive). 

As an IT Security Architect, I work in and across other ConnectedDrive departments to strengthen our organization’s security, compliance, and data privacy posture with a strong focus on Public Cloud environments. 
I design and align cloud security architectures, define policies and standards, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance and robust data protection for all IT products and projects managed in my department.
My goal is to enable secure, scalable, and compliant cloud adoption while supporting efficient and resilient business operations.

company.name: Peter Park
company.tagline: The barrier-free system for your parking lot.
company.description:
Einfahrt in die Zukunft: Wir definieren Parken neu.
Wir bei Peter Park schaffen eine Welt ohne Schranken. Mit unserer Vision, Mobilität einfacher, effizienter und menschlicher zu gestalten, verwandeln wir Parkflächen in intelligente Mobilitätszentren.

Was wir tun
Als führender Anbieter für digitales Parkraummanagement bieten wir Inhabern eine Gesamtlösung für Ihre Parkflächen. Wir verknüpfen modernste smarte Hardware mit einer KI-gestützten Software-Plattform und integrierten Payment-Lösungen. So ersetzen wir physische Barrieren durch nahtlose digitale Prozesse.

Wir sind ein Team aus Visionären, Technik-Experten und Machern mit Sitz in München. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an der Zukunft der urbanen Mobilität.
Begleite uns auf dem Weg in eine Welt ohne Schranken oder werde Teil unserer Mission!
________________________________

Entry into the Future: Redefining Parking.
At Peter Park, we are creating a world without barriers. Driven by our vision to make mobility simpler, more efficient, and more human-centered, we transform parking areas into intelligent mobility hubs.

What we do
As a leading provider of digital parking management, we offer owners a comprehensive end-to-end solution for their parking spaces. We combine state-of-the-art smart hardware with an AI-powered software platform and integrated payment solutions. In doing so, we replace physical barriers with seamless digital processes.

We are a team of visionaries, tech experts, and doers based in Munich. Together, we are shaping the future of urban mobility.
Join us on the journey toward a world without barriers and be part of our mission!
